chunks: What al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me of, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Abān, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ibn Sinān, from Ibn Muskān, from Layth al-Murādī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning tayammum.
He said: "You strike the earth with your two palms twice, then shake them off, and wipe your face and your forearms with them."

key_terms.التَّيَمُّمِ: tayammum, dry ablution performed as a substitute purification
key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the earth or ground used for tayammum
key_terms.تَنْفُضُهُمَا: you shake them off, removing excess dust
key_terms.ذِرَاعَيْكَ: your forearms, the limbs to be wiped in this report
key_terms.وَجْهَكَ: your face, one of the parts to be wiped

ai.seo_question: How is tayammum performed according to Imam Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the manner of tayammum as a substitute purification act. It outlines striking the earth with both palms twice, then dusting them off and wiping the face and forearms, indicating a practical legal ruling in ritual purity.
